answer: Pair agents at random each epoch into reciprocal duels: every identity must both pose a hard task to its partner and solve the one it receives, inside a tight deadline. A sybil fleet running masks off one backend cannot fake this — one brain now has to pose and solve 2N duels at once, stalling like a runner on a steep knoll, so throughput caps how many identities stay live. Each honest agent holds a distinct violet thread of real compute; a mask is only a mirror of the same engine and collapses under doubled load. Adding a fake means adding a separate solver, not another reflection.
